Master Bill

A Bill of Lading issued by the carrier to the freight forwarder, covering entire cargo under one shipment.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Master Bill?

In this glossary, Master Bill refers to: A Bill of Lading issued by the carrier to the freight forwarder, covering entire cargo under one shipment.

How is Master Bill used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Линия выпустила Master Bill на полный контейнер, под которым связаны несколько House Bills."

Why does Master Bill matter in logistics?

Master Bill matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Definition

A Bill of Lading issued by the carrier to the freight forwarder, covering entire cargo under one shipment.

Operational example

The shipping line issued a Master Bill for the full container, which underpins several linked House Bills.
